title: Chess.com Reached 200 Million Accounts After One Release Spike
hook: One television release nearly tripled monthly chess signups.
closing: The release created a spike, but the online chess habit kept growing.
question: What pulled you into chess?

segments.say: Chess.com reached 200 million registered accounts, proving the audience kept growing long after the release spike.
Monthly Chess.com signups jumped to 2.8 million after the release, nearly tripling the pandemic baseline.
Chess.com reached 200 million accounts, about one-third of estimated regular chess players worldwide.
